title: Design: Edit Vendor lists the vendor's inactive term last
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure a vendor is on Net 50.
  • Make sure Net 50 is deactivated.
  • Make sure Net 120 is active.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p7-07-edit-vendor-keeps-the-inactive-term.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the vendor page of that vendor.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the pencil on the vendor card.
  2. Click the "Credit Terms" box.
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "Edit Vendor" window opens with "Credit Terms" reading "Net 50 (Inactive)".

Step 2:

  • The list ends with Net 120, the shop's day-of-month terms, Credit Hold, then "Net 50 (Inactive)" last, ticked and highlighted (as in ct-p7-07-edit-vendor-keeps-the-inactive-term.png).

Step 3:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-R3: “A vendor on a deactivated term shows "{name} (Inactive)" on the vendor card's "Credit term" and selected in Edit Vendor, listed after the active terms, until someone picks another.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
